description: This Java source file defines a custom live wallpaper service for Android devices, featuring animated circles, background color changes, and display handling.

classes.name: SampleWallpaper
classes.description: A WallpaperService subclass that creates and manages a custom animated wallpaper.

classes.name: MySampleEngine
classes.description: Inner class extending Engine, responsible for rendering and interaction logic of the wallpaper.

methods.name: onCreateEngine
methods.description: Creates and returns an instance of the wallpaper engine.

methods.name: onCreate
methods.description: Initializes display, paint, and starts drawing.

methods.name: onComputeColors
methods.description: Provides wallpaper color information based on current background color.

methods.name: onVisibilityChanged
methods.description: Handles visibility changes to start or stop drawing.

methods.name: onTouchEvent
methods.description: Handles touch events to move the circle and invert direction.

methods.name: onSurfaceDestroyed
methods.description: Stops drawing when surface is destroyed.

methods.name: draw
methods.description: Performs the drawing of background, bitmap, text, and circle.

methods.name: invertCircleDirectionIfNeeded
methods.description: Inverts circle movement direction if it moves outside display bounds.

methods.name: updateShift
methods.description: Updates circle position and radius shift for animation.

methods.name: genNewShift
methods.description: Generates new random shift values for circle movement.

methods.name: genNewColor
methods.description: Generates new contrasting background and paint colors.

methods.name: initDisplay
methods.description: Initializes display and registers display listener.

methods.name: updateDisplay
methods.description: Updates display metrics and loads tip image.
